ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description: Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day. Features Go to: Options > Mod options > "Dawn of a New Day" # Enabled => You can toggle the overlay anytime without restarting. # Screenshot Mode => When in Screenshot Mode (F11), if enabled the overlay won't be displayed. # Show Example => Shows your current overlay configuration in the next tick to ease and familarize with the settings. - Appearance Section # Show Highlight => Adds a low-opacity light background behind the overlay. # Scale => Scales the whole overlay to your like (From 0.5x to 4x). # Offset Presets => Helps you to choose an offset of your liking without trial and error. # Offset sliders (px) => Choose offsets on X and Y axis at pixel-precision (From 0 To Screen Resolution). # Line Width (%) => Choose the width in percentage of the line that divides the Upper from Bottom (From 0 to 100). # Line Thickness (px) => Choose the thickness in pixels of the line that divides the Upper from Bottom (From 0 to 100) # Line Padding (px) => Choose the padding in pixels that divides the line from the Upper and Bottom (From 0 to 100) - Duration Section # Total Display Duration => Choose the total duration of the overlay in seconds (From 0 to 120). # Fade In Duration => Choose the duration of the overlay fading-in in seconds (From 0 to 120). # Fade Out Duration => Choose the duration of the overlay fading-out in seconds (From 0 to 120). - Text Section # Choose Font Family => Choose an custom OS font to replace the default game font of the text. # Font Size => Choose the character size of the text (From 1 to 256). # Outline Thickness => Choose the thickness of the outline of the text (From 0 to 10). # Bold => Enable to add bold style to the text. # Italic => Enable to add italic style to the text. # Text Color => Choose from the color presets the color of the text. # Outline Color => Choose from the color presets the color of the outline of the text. - Label Format Section # Upper Text Format => Choose the format of the Upper text. # Bottom Text Format => Choose the format of the Bottom text. * {D/d} => Full Day * {Y/y} => Full Year [eg. 5500] / 2-Digit Year [eg. 00] * {Q/q} => CAPS Quadrum / Quadrum * {S/s} => CAPS Season / Season * {H/h} => Full Hour [eg. 06] / Hour [eg. 6] - Extra Section # Starts at Zero => Enable to start the count of the days from 0 instead of 1. # Show Every X Days => Choose how often the overlay displays (From 1 to 1200) [eg. X=10 => DAY 10, DAY 20, DAY 30, ...]. # Trigger Hour => Choose at what hour of the day the overlay displays (From 0 to 23). # Day Relative => Choose what the value of day will be relative to. * Settle => Day will be relative to the day the colonists settled. * Quadrum => Day will be relative to the quadrum resetting itself after 15 days. * Season => Day will be relative to the season resetting itself after it ends. * Year => Day will be relative to the year resetting itself after 60 days. Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
